newsitem.title: USA: MAI Systems names Bayz CEO.
newsitem.headline: MAI Systems names Bayz CEO.

text.p: MAI Systems Corp said on Monday George Bayz, president, was named to the additional post of chief executive officer.
He replaces Richard Russler, who will continue as chairman,
In addition, Lewis Stanton was named executive vice president, chief operating officer and chief financial officer.
Bayz has been with the company since 1994 and has been chief operating officer since May 1995.

Stanton is currently chief executive officer of Worldsite Networks Inc, an Internet service provider. He replaces the current chief financial officer, W. Brian Kretzmer, who was named vice president, business development.
